description: Use this when the user asks for a stock's ValuEdge financial history, profitability, growth, balance-sheet evidence, business quality, or data coverage. An optional history_limit requests up to 30 periods of selected metrics, current EPS consensus for at most three future fiscal years where present, quarterly P/E samples from existing monthly observations, and bounded source-native annual income, balance-sheet, and cash-flow statement rows where the existing snapshot contains them. EPS is not normalized and past estimate revisions are unavailable. Selected metric trends remain distinct from the full annual statement JSON. Do not infer a trade instruction.

history_limit.description: Optional maximum number of recent annual/quarterly selected-metric rows and annual statement rows (1–30). Omit to preserve the existing compact response. Full annual statement rows retain source fields and currencies; missing source rows/provenance are reported, never filled. Current EPS consensus is capped separately at three future fiscal years; it is not normalized and past revisions are unavailable.
